messages:
rachel-billing: Urgent: customer Meridian Health Partners (acct MHP-443) failed ACH onboarding. Bank webhook says 'account_type_mismatch' on microdeposits. Invoice 54277 ($9,120) is due tomorrow; they requested a one-time wire to avoid suspension.
omar-payments: Paste the gateway error? could be corporate checking not supporting microdeposits or a routing format issue.
rachel-billing: Webhook: status=failed, decline_code=account_type_mismatch, bank_message='Microdeposit verification unsupported for account type - commercial'. Customer says treasury used their corporate sweep account.
ops-oncall: Pause autopay retries for MHP-443 to avoid duplicate charges. Add note to ticket.
billing-bot: Payment attempt 2027-06-02 15:20 UTC (txn: pay_v5c9) failed. Retry scheduled per policy.
omar-payments: For <$50k I'm fine accepting a wire with standard controls. Need VP approval and a signed addendum for audit. Also confirm customer covers any intermediary/outgoing fees.
nora-finance: No disputes on file. Approvals: VP needed only for >50k. So finance ok with wire if they confirm fees covered and send remittance to billing@redwood.ai.
cecilia-vpfinance: Confirmed: approve manual wire for invoice 54277 ($9,120). Conditions: 1) Remittance email to billing@redwood.ai with bank trace; 2) Signed one-off billing addendum uploaded; 3) Customer covers any bank/intermediary fees unless otherwise documented.
rachel-billing: Sending wire details + pro-forma to the customer now. Pausing retries.
rachel-billing: Wire instructions (sent):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Harbor Bank (US clearing)
Routing (ABA): 071000013
Account: 4455667788
SWIFT: HARBUS33
Reference: Invoice 54277 - MHP-443
Remittance email: billing@redwood.ai
Note: Please include full invoice amount and attach bank trace/reference in remittance email.
```
Customer reply: "Treasury initiating wire today; will send trace by EOD in our timezone and will include fees."
ops-oncall: Support confirmed autopay retries paused and ticket annotated to avoid duplicate capture.
omar-payments: After funds post we'll mark invoice paid and cancel the scheduled retries. Rachel: upload signed addendum and remittance email to audit folder when received.
rachel-billing: Will upload docs and update ledger after bank posts. Checklist: addendum pending, remittance pending.
billing-bot: Flag created: MANUAL_WIRE-7780. Audit log entry requested.
nora-finance: Thanks team 389 once bank posts I'll reconcile FX/fees and close the invoice."
